querystring.select: SELECT CCCP.CONTACT_PERSON_NAME AS Cpn, RMPOS.DESCR AS Jp, CCCP.JOB_TITLE_NAME AS Jtn,  RMGEN.DESCR AS G
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST_COMPANY_CONTACT_PERSON CCCP WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST_COMPANY CC WITH(NOLOCK) ON CC.CUST_COMPANY_ID = CCCP.CUST_COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMGEN WITH(NOLOCK) ON  RMGEN.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'GENDER' AND RMGEN.MASTER_CODE  = CCCP.MR_GENDER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMPOS WITH(NOLOCK) ON  RMPOS.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'JOB_POSITION' AND RMPOS.MASTER_CODE  = CCCP.MR_JOB_POSITION_CODE
